# Reason, evidence, and religious commitment

Compare David Hume and Søren Kierkegaard on the relationship between rational
inquiry and religious faith. What can evidence establish, and what might
religious commitment require beyond it?

Defend a focused comparative thesis using relevant primary-text discussion.
Avoid treating the thinkers as simple opposites. Distinguish speakers in Hume's
dialogues and Kierkegaard's pseudonymous voices where relevant. Consider a
serious objection to your comparison. You need not defend or reject religion;
your task is to evaluate the arguments fairly.
